hook.text: Odysseus tied himself to the mast so the Sirens' song couldn't lure him overboard. He decided before temptation hit.

buildup.text: A commitment device is a choice you make now that restricts your future options to keep yourself on track.

discovery.text: Cutting off your own escape route sounds irrational—but it works because future-you can't be trusted with willpower.

twist.text: Hernán Cortés burned his ships in Mexico. His soldiers had no choice but to fight forward.

climax.text: Automatic savings, public commitments, and deadlines all work because they remove the future choice to quit.

punchline.text: Lock the door. Throw away the key.

quiz.question: What is a commitment device?
options: A way to keep all options open
A present choice that restricts future options to enforce follow-through
